frontend.note: Preparation evidence advances the frontend head. The issued token binds the pushed preparation commit, not this observation.

userOutcome.operationalQuestion: Can an authorized participant load the exact assigned review, save a typed draft safely, and submit one immutable review result without disclosing another assignment?
userOutcome.primaryAction: open an assigned review, complete typed form answers, save with concurrency protection, and submit once
userOutcome.pageArchetype: assigned-review workspace with form navigation, draft status, validation summary and guarded submit
userOutcome.boundedOutcome: review assignment, draft and immutable submission are governed by exact tenant, assignment, purpose, population and field projection evidence

operations.rule: Entry-query actions are cycle operations only and must not impersonate assigned-review actions.

included: assigned-review domain, application service, repository, controller and owner PEP integration
typed form, rubric, answer, draft and immutable submission handling
tenant and assignment isolation, purpose/population/field projection enforcement
idempotent draft and submit commands with expected-version CAS
V18 clean and V17-to-V18 upgrade migration
accessible assigned-review frontend states and targeted recovery behavior
excluded: IAQ-022 cycle creation or validation implementation beyond consuming its sealed discovery boundary
compensation planning behavior or V17 mutation
goal, calibration, talent, learning or payroll features
menu, route or HRIS shell redesign
feature enablement, customer data, policy activation or production release

runtimeSecurityRollout.tenantContext: trusted Gateway/owner context plus repository isolation; request body and browser-supplied trusted headers are never authoritative
runtimeSecurityRollout.population: SELF or TARGET_POPULATION only when the current assignment authorizes the actor
runtimeSecurityRollout.fieldProjection: PERFORMANCE_ASSIGNED and PERFORMANCE_REVIEW_PRIVATE according to the v42 owner decision
runtimeSecurityRollout.idempotency: same key and canonical request digest returns the original result; mismatched reuse fails with no side effect
runtimeSecurityRollout.optimisticConcurrency: draft and submit require If-Match/expected version and stale commands fail without side effects
runtimeSecurityRollout.featureFlag: module-owned PER-013 flag if one is needed

implementationOrdering.beforeStartToken: Pin the corrected v42 authorization/OpenAPI/Gateway/AsyncAPI control bridge, reserve V18, and materialize clean dedicated worktrees.
implementationOrdering.afterStartToken: Implement the People assigned-review owner slice and PER frontend only within the sealed touch manifest, then commit and push module branches without merging dwp-dev.
implementationOrdering.antiCircularityRule: PER runtime implementation and its acceptance tests are module deliverables and are not prerequisites for issuing the token that authorizes them.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Owner and browser operations consume and produce the sealed review form, rubric, typed-answer, ETag, merge-patch and Problem Details contracts without local shadow DTO drift.
The canonical synthetic assigned-review fixture loads, saves and submits with stable hashes, order and decimal representation.
Wrong tenant, actor, assignment, purpose, population or field projection is denied before disclosure and cross-scope reads remain opaque.
IAQ-022 exposes only cycle operations and neither routes nor labels it as an assigned-review mutation surface.
Exact retry is stable; mismatched idempotency reuse and stale CAS create no draft, submission, receipt or outbox side effect.
A successful submit atomically records one immutable submission and one minimized PerformanceReviewSubmitted.v1 outbox fact.
V18 passes clean migration and V17-to-V18 upgrade while preserving compensation-planning V17 data and checksum assumptions.
The UI proves loading, empty, denied, partial failure, retry/recovery, keyboard, focus, accessible naming, high contrast, reduced motion and 200-percent zoom behavior.

verificationPlan.policy: CHANGED_CLUSTER_FIRST_THEN_SLICE_CONTRACT_AND_ONE_MODULE_BATCH; do not rerun broad repository suites after each finding.
backend: draft/submit idempotency, CAS and atomic outbox tests
V18 clean and V17 upgrade migration tests plus compensation compatibility assertion
frontend: one PER-013 slice test covering all sealed UI states and accessibility
final: clean module branches pushed without merging dwp-dev

deliverables: backend and frontend module branch commits and upstream push evidence
all eight acceptance results with exact test commands
V18 clean and V17-to-V18 upgrade evidence
authorization, tenant isolation, idempotency, CAS and exactly-once event evidence
changed-path manifest proving control-only and protected paths were not edited
